What can I say that hasn't been said by others? This game is possibly the greatest indie game run by the greatest indie developers of all time. It paved the way for other great indie titles like Stardew Valley and their like, and set a standard of care towards a game and it's community that has set a precedent for all indie developers moving forward. They are pioneers that have made a game that is beautiful and fun to explore. A game I can put down and forget about and revisit a year later and be amazed at everything they added and fall in love with the game all over again. They made a game they love so we could love it too. You can read a bunch of other reviews to find out what the game is like. I figured, after all the hours I've put into this game, I owed it a review. This game brought me close friends while on TDY in Alaska when I was still in the Air Force. This game gave me something to bond over with my son. This game was a distraction when I was feeling down. Thank you to the developers for never being able to quit working on this masterpiece. I love it.
